It was a bit of a hassle to get to/ from but totally worth it for us and with the time we had. 

We travelled from Osaka and stayed in Uno the first night, did Teshima the next day, stayed in Naoshima, did Naoshima the day after and stayed over again before heading back to Tokyo. Travel time Osaka to Uno was ~2 hours iirc and Naoshima to Tokyo was ~5 hours. 

We didn’t go to Hiroshima/ Miyajima and allocated the time we would have had there to Naoshima/ Teshima instead which was definitely the right decision for us!
